title: Sunflower
style: jazz, big band jazz, authentic jazz, international jazz, brass section, muted trumpet, tenor saxophone, walking bass, brushed snare, ride cymbal swing, upright piano comping, rhythm section breaks, horn stabs, call and response, spoken intro, 96 BPM, dry room reverb, tape saturation, syncopated backbeat, bittersweet warmth
lyrics:
I'm so happy to hear about sunflowers!

They are truly beautiful and can bring so much joy to our lives.

Here is a poem I have written about sunflowers:

Sun flowers are bright and warm,

They bring so much joy to our hearts.

Their golden faces shine so brightly,

They are truly beautiful and can make us smile.

Sun flowers are a symbol of happiness and hope,

They remind us of the beauty of life.

So let us always cherish the sun flowers in our lives,

May they always bring us joy and happiness.
